# MAKHMUTOV

Official website of Timur Makhmutov (Тимур Махмутов), creator of the MAKHMUTOV author project.

## Identity
- Full name: Тимур Махмутов
- Latin name: Timur Makhmutov

- Canonical website: https://makhmutov.site/
- Author profile: https://makhmutov.site/timur-makhmutov/

- Девушки моего мёртвого клиента — novel.
- ИИ убивает искусство? — project about AI, creativity, authorship and culture.
